tasks.title: The P term from the error
tasks.solution: Kp = p_roll · 0.032, P = Kp · e. For the default 45 and an error of 50 °/s: 1.44 · 50 = 72. The mixer divides the sum by 1000, and the axis limit is pidsum_limit = 500.

tasks.title: The time to the I-term limit
tasks.solution: The I limit = iterm_windup/100 · pidsum_limit. Ki = i_roll · 0.244, and I grows at Ki · e per second, so t = limit / (Ki · e). For the defaults (80, 80) and an error of 10 °/s: 400 / 195.2 = 2.05 s.

tasks.title: The effective D under TPA
tasks.solution: t = (throttle − 1000)/1000, tbp = (tpa_breakpoint − 1000)/1000; the factor = 1 − tpa_rate/100 · (t − tbp)/(1 − tbp) (pidUpdateTpaFactor(), pid_init.c). The defaults 65/1350, throttle 2000: 1 − 0.65 · 0.65/0.65 = 0.35, D 30 → 10.5.

tasks.title: The motor output with thrust_linear
tasks.solution: Output = x · (1 + k · (1 − x)²), k = thrust_linear/100 (pidApplyThrustLinearization()). At 40 and x = 0.10: 0.1 · (1 + 0.4 · 0.81) = 0.132; the slope at zero is 1 + k, and at x = 1/3 it is 1 again.

tasks.title: The top cut by vbat_sag_compensation
tasks.solution: The upper point is hard-coded — 4.20 V. Goodness = 1 − (4.20 − V)/(4.20 − V_warn), cut = (4.20 − V_warn)/4.20 · goodness · c/100. The default 350 and 100 %: at 4.20 V the cut is 16.7 %, at 3.85 V — 8.3 %, below 3.50 V — 0.
